For CBC/OFB/CFB8/CFB128 operations, the AES_IV_MEM memory stores the Initialization Vector (IV).
For the CTR operation, the AES_IV_MEM memory stores the Initial Counter Block (ICB).

AES_IV_MEM stores data following the Endianness pattern presented in Table 19.5-4, i.e., the most significant (i.e., left-most) byte Byte0 is stored at the lowest address while the least significant (i.e., right-most) byte Byte15 at the highest address.
